long_biography.plain_text:
In 1996, Sheikh Abdulrahman bin Ahmed M Al Thani established Al Wajba Establishment as a Qatari distributor of commercial vehicles and heavy machinery. It grew into a supply and service business spanning trucks, buses, construction equipment and agricultural machinery. The company still identifies him as chairman while its managers have moved into solar, water and environmental systems.

Al Wajba Motors extended that distribution model into high-end car dealerships. As owner, he backed customer test-drive events and dedicated showrooms rather than treating the marques as passive investments. Bentley, Lamborghini and Bugatti became central to the business; McLaren was part of its earlier expansion. The dealership strategy made automotive distribution his defining commercial platform.

Bentley, Lamborghini and Bugatti became central to the business; McLaren was part of its earlier expansion. The dealership strategy made automotive distribution his defining commercial platform.
